title: Bob Lazar's claim of reverse engineering at S4

plain: This is the story of Bob Lazar, a man who said he worked on alien craft for the US government. According to Lazar, in the late 1980s he worked at a place called S4, a secret site near Area 51, the highly secret military base in the Nevada desert. He says his job was to reverse engineer, meaning take apart and figure out, the propulsion system of a craft not made by human hands. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells this many times, adding that Lazar went public on TV in 1989, with the help of a journalist, George Knapp, and a pilot named John Lear. Michels also repeats how Lazar says he was recruited: after strapping a jet engine onto a Honda and meeting the physicist Edward Teller by chance. The talk show host Joe Rogan stresses Lazar's descriptions of craft that bend gravity around themselves, and points to a documentary by the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, while a neuroscientist, Andrew Gallimore, recalls being struck by Lazar on Rogan's show. If true, it would mean the government holds a working non-human craft and has studied it for decades.
